environment.description: Same ASP.NET Core 8.0 API on ECS Fargate (single task) but origin is NOT publicly accessible. The ALB security group ingress is restricted to the CloudFront managed prefix list (com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing). CloudFront distribution has a custom origin with Origin Access Control (OAC) header validation disabled but uses a Signed URL policy: all requests to /api/promotion/* require a valid CloudFront signed URL with a custom policy specifying a 2-second URL lifetime (DateLessThan constraint). The CloudFront key pair uses a 2048-bit RSA key managed in Parameter Store. The signed URL includes the client IP condition (IpAddress field in the custom policy restricts to the requester's /32 CIDR). CloudFront has a cache behavior with 'Origin request policy: AllViewer' and TTL=0 (no caching). The distribution also has a field-level encryption profile applied to the POST body 'PromoCode' field using a separate RSA public key, meaning the origin receives the promo code encrypted and must decrypt it server-side before processing (adding ~200ms latency that serializes the check-then-act window per unique encrypted payload).

config.origin_access: CloudFront only (SG restricted to com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing prefix list)
config.field_level_encryption: PromoCode field encrypted with RSA-2048, decrypted server-side
